item.title: Drop in theft crimes and public order incidents recorded in Kerry during 2025
item.description: There has been a drop in theft crime in Kerry during 2025. That’s according to figures released to Radio Kerry by the Regional Chief Superintendent for the Southern Garda Region, Colm O’Sullivan. It shows there has also been a fall in public order incidents when compared with 2024. Advertisement According to the figures, as of December 15th, there has been a 7% drop in theft from shop incidents in Kerry, at 642 in 2025. item.title: 2025 saw lowest commencement of homes in Kerry in ten years
item.description: Construction activity on new homes in Kerry is at its lowest level in ten years. Data from the Department of Housing shows that just 297 new homes were commenced in Kerry in 2025, which is the lowest yearly total of commencements since 2016. It comes as estate agents in the county warn that a shortage of new homes is leading to increased house prices, with a very high demand. item.title: Leinster to host Edinburgh; Munster away to Exeter
item.description: Leinster will host Edinburgh in the last-16 of the Investec Champions Cup, following the conclusion of the pool stages last night. A win for Leo Cullen's side in that game would set up a home quarter-final against either Harlequins or Sale Sharks - but they could face Glasgow Warriors away in the semis. item.title: Everton into top half of Premier League
item.description: Everton are into the top half of the Premier League thanks to last night's 1-nil victory at third-placed Aston Villa. They've now won four of their last six away games. The hosts failed in their bid to close the gap to leaders Arsenal who are now 7 points clear at the top. Advertisement Newcastle missed the chance to go fifth with a goalless draw at bottom side Wolves. There's one game in the league this evening. Brighton take on Bournemouth knowing a win would take them above Everton into 10th.

item.title: Kyren Wilson claims Masters
item.description: England's Kyren Wilson claimed his first Masters snooker title with a 10-6 victory over John Higgins. Last year's runner-up had lost both his previous appearances in the final of the tournament at Alexandra Palace. Wilson's added to his only other Triple Crown success at the World Championship in 2024. Advertisement
